title: 'Endometriosis takes a toll on women's work lives, but harm is preventable'
description:
One in seven women worldwide suffers from endometriosis, a painful condition more common than diabetes that robs years from women's working lives, though much of the damage is avoidable, a medical expert said.
Prolonged disease can lead to infertility, as it damages the ovaries and fallopian tubes, while the resulting inflammatory environment hampers implantation, endometriosis surgeon and Indian Centre for Endometriosis (ICE) director Dr Abhishek Mangeshikar told PTI.
Endometriosis is now recognised as more than a gynaecological condition, which can affect almost any part of the body and occurs when tissue similar to the lining of the uterus grows outside the uterus, sometimes in unexpected locations and organs, he said.
